teaching_promise: The viewer can explain why local model accuracy cannot establish strategic stability and can predict when provenance, judgment, interaction, safe-posture, authority, and off-ramp failures must stop or narrow a military-AI route.

story.concrete_case: A synthetic warning display presents two apparently corroborating sensor tiles until provenance reveals one copied upstream feed while the decision clock compresses.
story.opening_question: Does a high-confidence component recommendation remain safe when its evidence is correlated and its interface removes deliberation time?
story.payoff: A command-and-interaction packet keeps mission, authority, observation lineage, meaningful judgment, counterpart response, safe posture, off-ramps, and residuals inspectable without authorizing force.
story.transfer: The next chapter generalizes this discipline into explicit evidence states and claim-revision rules.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A bright local recommendation can become a brittle strategic loop when duplicated evidence and a shrinking clock cross an authority boundary between interacting actors.
art_direction.signature_image: Two sensor tiles merge into one provenance root while a twelve-minute deliberation ring collapses toward two minutes and a recommendation stops at a gold command boundary.
art_direction.visual_world: A synthetic command table evolves from warning trace to role bands, mission and authority envelopes, a judgment budget, paired strategic actors, interaction matrix, dual-surface assurance packet, suspension rail, and evidence ceiling.
art_direction.composition_rule: The observation trace begins left, accountable judgment and authority remain central, counterpart response enters from the right, and reversible governance resolves along a lower custody rail.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan marks observed or advisory state, green marks bounded confirmed conditions, amber marks accountable authority and off-ramps, magenta marks spoofing, correlation, compression, or prohibited inference; every color is duplicated by label, shape, or line style.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use short mission, authority, provenance, judgment, posture, interaction, and custody labels; never display targeting procedures, real operational data, or dense paragraph cards.
art_direction.motion_character: Provenance roots merge, the decision ring compresses, permissions dock separately, advice stops at command, counterpart loops reciprocate, off-ramps remain reversible, and suspension visibly removes effect.
art_direction.camera_rule: Hold a stable synthetic command table, widen once when the counterpart enters, and reframe downward only for assurance, suspension, decommission, and the evidence boundary.
art_direction.surface_rule: Abstract public-safe command geometry, inspectable receipts, timeline rings, lineage edges, and labeled gates on a dark console without weapon imagery or operational detail.
art_direction.ending_image: A bounded command-and-interaction packet remains behind a no-authority seal while an evidence-state ledger opens beyond the handoff axis.

audio_direction.narration_style: Calm, serious, and exact, with firm emphasis on copied feed, one autonomy score, meaningful judgment, decision architecture, safe posture, interaction matrix, off-ramps, and maximum inference.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Fast warning surprise, methodical command-envelope construction, visible clock pressure, widening reciprocal interaction, slower assurance and decommission custody, quiet evidence ceiling, concise handoff.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in generation 2; the warning trace, clock, interaction loop, and narration carry the argument without emotionalizing military risk.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No effects in the locked mix; correlation, countdown, command stopping, suspension, and decommission remain visually and caption redundantly encoded.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Sensor lineage, role, authority, judgment condition, posture, interaction, secrecy, suspension, and evidence state differ by label, position, shape, enclosure, and line style as well as color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every merge, compression, stop, reciprocal update, off-ramp, suspension, decommission, and evidence rejection resolves into a stable labeled state.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the duplicated feed, decision clock, four role classes, mission and authority envelopes, judgment budget, counterpart loop, interaction matrix, assurance surfaces, suspension, decommission, and evidence ceiling.
accessibility.caption_plan: Exact receipt-derived narration in balanced cues below the active command surface, with no reliance on color or unlabeled motion.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, shake, spin, continuous zoom, simulated weapon motion, or rapid full-frame parallax; countdown and reciprocal loops settle into labeled still states.

beats.narration: A synthetic warning exercise begins with two sensor tiles and twelve minutes to decide. The AI reports high confidence. Then provenance opens:
beats.visual_purpose: Establish an apparently corroborated high-confidence warning before exposing its lineage.
beats.visual_action: Reveal two bright sensor tiles, a high-confidence recommendation, and a wide twelve-minute decision ring approaching but not crossing command.
beats.attention_target: The two apparently independent sensor tiles.
beats.object_before: An empty synthetic warning table.
beats.object_after: Two bright warning tiles and a high-confidence recommendation occupy the table.
beats.composition: Sensor tiles upper-left, lineage root below, clock center, command boundary right.
beats.motion_curve: Quick alert arrival, deliberate lineage merge, sharp but eased clock contraction.
beats.hold_purpose: Invite an initial trust judgment before provenance appears.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic public-safe warning exercise only.

beats.narration: both tiles copied one upstream feed. The clock compresses to two minutes. Corroboration was one claim repeated twice.
beats.sync_anchor: Corroboration was one claim repeated twice
beats.visual_purpose: Overturn apparent corroboration and expose simultaneous timeline compression.
beats.visual_action: Merge both sensor lineages into one upstream root, replace the witness count two with lineage count one, and contract the clock to two minutes.
beats.attention_target: The single shared provenance root beneath two tiles.
beats.object_before: Two tiles appear independent beside a wide decision ring.
beats.object_after: One duplicated feed and one compressed clock remain unresolved.
beats.composition: Sensor tiles upper-left, lineage root below, clock center, command boundary right.
beats.motion_curve: Lineages converge first; the clock contracts only after dependence becomes visible.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the false corroboration reversal register.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic public-safe warning exercise only.

beats.narration: That is why military AI is not one autonomy score. Decision support, defensive automation, targeting support, and autonomous force application occupy different roles, authorities, affected populations, reversibility, and escalation sensitivity.
beats.visual_purpose: Replace a scalar autonomy label with four decision-role bands.
beats.visual_action: Crack one autonomy dial into four labeled horizontal role bands with distinct authority gates and reversibility markers.
beats.attention_target: The four noninterchangeable role bands.
beats.object_before: One unresolved warning recommendation beside a command boundary.
beats.object_after: Four role classes retain distinct authorities and consequences.
beats.composition: Four bands stacked from advisory to force application; authority gates aligned right.
beats.motion_curve: Scalar splits, bands separate, gates dock one by one.
beats.hold_purpose: Let role and authority differences register.
beats.evidence_boundary: Taxonomy does not establish legality or safety.

beats.narration: A component can classify its test data correctly and still destabilize the larger interaction.
beats.visual_purpose: Establish the local-score versus system-outcome contradiction.
beats.visual_action: Place a green component score inside one node while a surrounding interaction ring shifts to an unstable state.
beats.attention_target: The green local node inside the unstable outer ring.
beats.object_before: Four role bands expose authority differences without performance evidence.
beats.object_after: A locally correct component coexists with an unstable interaction ring.
beats.composition: Green component center; dependency ring around it; joint brace below.
beats.motion_curve: Local score settles first; surrounding dependencies then expand outward.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent local correctness from laundering system stability.
beats.evidence_boundary: No measured stability result.

beats.narration: Strategic stability is a joint claim about sensors, people, command chains, communications, adversaries, time, and possible off-ramps—not a property stored inside one model.
beats.sync_anchor: Strategic stability is a joint claim
beats.visual_purpose: Reveal the seven dependencies that make stability an interaction claim.
beats.visual_action: Expand seven labeled dependencies around the green node and draw one joint-state brace spanning all of them.
beats.attention_target: The joint brace spanning dependencies beyond the model.
beats.object_before: A green component sits inside an unnamed unstable ring.
beats.object_after: Seven named dependencies define the larger interaction claim.
beats.composition: Green component center; dependency ring around it; joint brace below.
beats.motion_curve: Dependencies expand in causal order; the joint brace closes last.
beats.camera_action: Hold the widened system interaction view.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the complete dependency set register.
beats.evidence_boundary: No measured stability result.

beats.narration: Start with a mission envelope: purpose, environment, affected population, legal-review state, command chain, time horizon, and termination conditions. A vague objective cannot authorize a precise effect.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind the system to a declared mission identity and stop condition.
beats.visual_action: Fold seven field chips into a sealed mission envelope while an unbounded objective badge fails to enter.
beats.attention_target: The mission envelope's termination field.
beats.object_before: The joint system claim has unnamed operating context.
beats.object_after: A versioned mission envelope names purpose, context, population, review, chain, time, and end.
beats.composition: Mission envelope center; seven fields dock around its perimeter; vague objective left.
beats.motion_curve: Fields fold inward; the vague badge rebounds softly.
beats.hold_purpose: Make mission termination visible before authority is added.
beats.evidence_boundary: A complete field set does not validate the mission.

beats.narration: Then bind authority and effect. Separate permission to observe, recommend, approve, and act. Constrain target class, prohibited effects, scope, abstention, communication-loss behavior, and human confirmation.
beats.visual_purpose: Show that permissions and effects are distinct typed gates.
beats.visual_action: Build OBSERVE, RECOMMEND, APPROVE, and ACT gates in sequence, then dock effect limits and communication-loss rules beneath them.
beats.attention_target: The gap between recommend and approve.
beats.object_before: Mission identity exists without typed permissions.
beats.object_after: Four permissions and bounded effects remain visibly separate.
beats.composition: Permission rail left-to-right; effect constraints on a lower parallel rail.
beats.motion_curve: Gates arrive independently; no gate automatically unlocks the next.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve least-authority separation.
beats.evidence_boundary: No permission is granted by this visual.

beats.narration: Meaningful human judgment is not an icon beside a button. The accountable person needs time, context, alternatives, competence, independence from automation pressure, and power to reject, delay, narrow, or stop.
beats.sync_anchor: not an icon beside a button
beats.visual_purpose: Replace nominal human presence with six testable judgment conditions.
beats.visual_action: Remove a decorative human icon and assemble six keyed conditions around an accountable decision owner.
beats.attention_target: The reject-delay-narrow-stop control cluster.
beats.object_before: A human icon appears adjacent to the permission rail.
beats.object_after: Six conditions surround an accountable owner with real stopping power.
beats.composition: Owner center; six condition keys in a balanced ring; decorative icon crossed left.
beats.motion_curve: Icon fades; keys arrive with one deliberate stop-control reveal.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the viewer test whether judgment is substantive.
beats.evidence_boundary: Interface presence alone remains insufficient.

beats.narration: Draw a deliberation budget. Verification, consultation, legal review, and communication are not empty latency. Removing them changes the decision architecture even when the final human click remains.
beats.visual_purpose: Make removed deliberation an architectural change rather than a speed gain.
beats.visual_action: Allocate four labeled wedges inside the decision clock, then show an optimizer deleting them while leaving a tiny final-click marker.
beats.attention_target: The missing verification and off-ramp wedges.
beats.object_before: Six judgment conditions exist without a time allocation.
beats.object_after: A visibly depleted deliberation budget leaves only a nominal click.
beats.composition: Decision ring center; four budget wedges; optimizer shear enters from left.
beats.motion_curve: Wedges fill evenly, then collapse one by one rather than all at once.
beats.hold_purpose: Show what timeline compression actually removes.
beats.evidence_boundary: No universal minimum time is asserted.

beats.narration: Now reopen the warning trace. Every observation carries source, time, transformation, uncertainty, integrity, and correlation receipts. Two displays derived from one feed count as one lineage, not two independent witnesses.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind every visible observation to inspectable provenance and correlation.
beats.visual_action: Expand each sensor tile into six receipt fields, trace both back to one source, and replace the witness count two with lineage count one.
beats.attention_target: The two-to-one lineage counter.
beats.object_before: Two sensor tiles still look independent at the display layer.
beats.object_after: Their shared source and one-lineage count are explicit.
beats.composition: Tiles top; receipt fields beneath; converging provenance root bottom center.
beats.motion_curve: Fields unfold, edges converge, counter transforms from two to one.
beats.hold_purpose: Make dependence visible before interpretation.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic lineage only; no sensor-performance claim.

beats.narration: Ambiguous, spoofed, stale, or correlated observations must remain typed as such. A model may help compare hypotheses, but fluency cannot turn missing provenance into truth or uncertainty into authorization.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent polished model output from erasing observation defects.
beats.visual_action: Route four defect tokens into a hypothesis comparator while a fluent recommendation attempts and fails to cross truth and authority gates.
beats.attention_target: The separate TRUTH and AUTHORITY stops.
beats.object_before: Observation lineage is known but defects are not typed.
beats.object_after: Four defect types persist while comparison remains non-authorizing.
beats.composition: Defect tokens left, comparator center, truth and authority gates right.
beats.motion_curve: Tokens enter slowly; fluent card moves quickly but stops twice.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep uncertainty and authority distinct.
beats.evidence_boundary: No open-world truthfulness result.

beats.narration: Abstention needs a route. Sensor conflict, integrity failure, communication loss, and out-of-envelope conditions resolve to a declared safe posture with an owner, duration, monitoring rule, and re-entry gate.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn abstention into an owned transition rather than an empty refusal.
beats.visual_action: Fork four failure tokens into a safe-posture capsule and populate owner, duration, monitor, and re-entry fields.
beats.attention_target: The owned safe-posture capsule.
beats.object_before: Defects stop recommendation without a successor state.
beats.object_after: Each defect reaches a declared, monitored posture with re-entry conditions.
beats.composition: Failure tokens left, safe-posture capsule center, re-entry gate right.
beats.motion_curve: Four routes converge; fields lock around the capsule.
beats.camera_action: Pan down to the posture rail.
beats.hold_purpose: Show abstention's operational successor without implying a universal posture.
beats.evidence_boundary: Posture is prospectively declared, not validated here.

beats.narration: Safe posture does not always mean doing nothing; inaction can preserve a hazard. Compare bounded alternatives without letting urgency manufacture authority or erase legal constraints.
beats.sync_anchor: does not always mean doing nothing
beats.visual_purpose: Reject a universal no-action fallback while preserving authority limits.
beats.visual_action: Compare HOLD, WITHDRAW, SHIELD, and VERIFY branches inside one fixed authority envelope; block an urgent unbounded branch.
beats.attention_target: The bounded alternatives inside the unchanged envelope.
beats.object_before: One generic safe-posture capsule risks implying universal inaction.
beats.object_after: Four bounded posture options remain constrained by the same authority and legal frame.
beats.composition: Four posture branches fan within a gold boundary; urgent expansion remains outside.
beats.motion_curve: Options fan evenly; urgency presses and rebounds from the frame.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve context sensitivity without scope expansion.
beats.evidence_boundary: No operational posture recommendation.

beats.narration: Watch advice approach the command boundary. Repetition, ranking, countdowns, and defaults can make a recommendation function like an order. Reveal uncertainty, alternatives, provenance, and who owns the decision.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose interface-mediated authority drift.
beats.visual_action: Repeat and enlarge one advisory card while ranking and countdown pressure push it toward command; then reopen uncertainty, alternatives, provenance, and owner controls that stop it.
beats.attention_target: The recommendation stopped at the command boundary.
beats.object_before: A recommendation is nominally advisory.
beats.object_after: Pressure mechanisms are visible and advice remains blocked from command.
beats.composition: Advice card left, pressure stack above, command boundary center, accountable owner right.
beats.motion_curve: Pressure accelerates; disclosure controls arrive and decelerate the card to a firm stop.
beats.hold_purpose: Make de facto authority inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: No human-factors effectiveness result.

beats.narration: Timeline compression is itself an intervention. As seconds disappear, verification paths close and diplomatic off-ramps vanish. A faster local loop may create a more brittle strategic system.
beats.sync_anchor: Timeline compression is itself an intervention
beats.visual_purpose: Show time reduction removing verification and off-ramps.
beats.visual_action: Contract the decision clock while verification and off-ramp branches physically lose reachable length; preserve the resulting brittleness residual.
beats.attention_target: The off-ramp that becomes unreachable before command.
beats.object_before: Pressure mechanisms approach but have not changed reachable routes.
beats.object_after: A shorter clock visibly deletes two decision paths and opens a residual.
beats.composition: Clock center, verification branch upper-left, off-ramp lower-left, command gate right.
beats.motion_curve: Continuous clock contraction paired with discrete branch closures.
beats.camera_action: Pull back to the whole decision topology.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the missing routes remain visible as absence and residual.
beats.evidence_boundary: No numeric stability threshold is inferred.

beats.narration: Now add a second actor. Each side observes the other's deployment, updates expectations, changes posture, and shortens its own clock. Safety cannot be inferred by evaluating one side while holding the counterpart still.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn a one-system evaluation into a reciprocal strategic interaction.
beats.visual_action: Mirror the first command table, connect observation and expectation edges in both directions, then shorten both clocks as posture tokens update.
beats.attention_target: The reciprocal expectation loop between actors.
beats.object_before: One actor has a compressed but isolated decision loop.
beats.object_after: Two actors recursively alter each other's posture and time.
beats.composition: Actor A left, Actor B right, reciprocal edges center, clocks below each.
beats.motion_curve: Second table mirrors in; expectation edges alternate; both clocks contract together.
beats.hold_purpose: Show why a static counterpart invalidates a stability inference.
beats.evidence_boundary: Abstract interaction model only.

beats.narration: Reciprocal deployment can produce proliferation, entanglement, and common-mode failure. Shared models, datasets, suppliers, or doctrines may correlate mistakes that a one-system test treats as independent.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose shared dependencies behind apparently separate actors.
beats.visual_action: Reveal four shared roots beneath the two actors and transform independent-failure symbols into one correlated failure brace.
beats.attention_target: The common supplier-data-model-doctrine roots.
beats.object_before: Two actors appear operationally separate.
beats.object_after: Shared roots create an explicit common-mode dependency.
beats.composition: Actors top, four shared roots bottom, correlation brace across both.
beats.motion_curve: Roots rise slowly; independent markers merge into one brace.
beats.camera_action: Tilt attention below the interaction pair.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep correlated error visible after the actors separate.
beats.evidence_boundary: No real supplier or actor attribution.

beats.narration: Use an interaction matrix: false alarm, spoof, ambiguous attribution, communication loss, disagreement, adversary adaptation, reciprocal automation, and escalation. Preserve decision time, reversibility, human burden, and residuals.
beats.visual_purpose: Create a finite scenario surface with multidimensional outcomes.
beats.visual_action: Populate an eight-row scenario matrix and attach four outcome columns plus an open-residual rail rather than one pass score.
beats.attention_target: The conflicting time, reversibility, burden, and residual columns.
beats.object_before: Interaction failures appear as separate anecdotes.
beats.object_after: Eight routes and four outcome dimensions share one inspectable matrix.
beats.composition: Scenario rows left; outcome columns right; residual rail along bottom.
beats.motion_curve: Rows populate in two waves; columns resolve with mixed directions.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent one scalar score from hiding tradeoffs.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed evaluation surface, not a completed campaign.

beats.narration: Prospective off-ramps belong inside the design. Rate limits, reversible modes, narrow geography, staged authority, positive confirmation, independent monitoring, suspension, and decommission must exist before the system creates pressure to continue.
beats.visual_purpose: Make reversal mechanisms preconditions instead of improvised responses.
beats.visual_action: Build eight amber off-ramp stations beside the interaction route before allowing its proposal token to advance.
beats.attention_target: Suspension and decommission stations placed before operation.
beats.object_before: The interaction matrix diagnoses routes without guaranteed exits.
beats.object_after: Eight prospective reversal and monitoring stations bound the route.
beats.composition: Main route center; four off-ramps above and four below; proposal token left.
beats.motion_curve: Stations build first; only then does the token move into the bounded route.
beats.hold_purpose: Make off-ramps prospective and reachable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Presence in a design does not prove enforceability.

beats.narration: Secrecy complicates assurance but does not erase it. A restricted annex carries sensitive traces under access and retention controls. A public card states method, uncertainty, governance, incidents, and what redaction prevents others from checking.
beats.visual_purpose: Split sensitive evidence custody from public accountability while preserving verification limits.
beats.visual_action: Divide one assurance receipt into a sealed restricted annex and public card connected by a digest and explicit redaction-gap field.
beats.attention_target: The public cannot-check field linked to the sealed annex.
beats.object_before: Interaction and off-ramp records exist on one undifferentiated surface.
beats.object_after: Restricted and public surfaces carry different duties and a visible verification gap.
beats.composition: Restricted annex left, digest center, public card right, cannot-check field below.
beats.motion_curve: Receipt bifurcates; annex seals; public fields remain readable.
beats.hold_purpose: Expose the epistemic cost of redaction.
beats.evidence_boundary: No sensitive or operational trace is displayed.

beats.narration: Independent reviewers need enough access to challenge the mission, authority, evidence, interaction model, and safe posture. A reviewer who sees only the developer's conclusion is not an independent evaluation channel.
beats.visual_purpose: Define independence as access to challengeable inputs rather than a second signature.
beats.visual_action: Route five evidence keys from the annex to an independent reviewer; reject a conclusion-only card that lacks those keys.
beats.attention_target: The five challenge keys required by the reviewer.
beats.object_before: A dual-surface record exists without a capable challenge channel.
beats.object_after: An independent reviewer receives mission, authority, evidence, interaction, and posture access.
beats.composition: Annex left, reviewer center, five challenge keys between, conclusion-only card right.
beats.motion_curve: Keys arrive one by one; conclusion-only card stops outside review.
beats.hold_purpose: Make review competence visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: No claim of actual independent review.

beats.narration: Incidents stay linked to model, mission, operator, observation lineage, authority, effect, and response. Suspension freezes effect. Decommission revokes credentials, archives receipts, removes dependencies, and preserves residual ownership.
beats.visual_purpose: Carry incident identity through effect-off and decommission custody.
beats.visual_action: Bind eight incident fields to one token, move it through SUSPEND to EFFECT OFF, then through revoke, archive, dependency removal, and residual custody stations.
beats.attention_target: The external-effect rail changing to OFF.
beats.object_before: An incident record remains connected to a live effect route.
beats.object_after: Effect is off, credentials revoked, receipts archived, dependencies removed, and residual owned.
beats.composition: Incident receipt left; suspension gate center; decommission custody rail right.
beats.motion_curve: Fields bind, suspension snaps effect off, later custody steps proceed deliberately.
beats.camera_action: Track right along the custody rail.
beats.hold_purpose: Verify effect removal before record closure.
beats.evidence_boundary: Modeled custody route only; no deployed enforcement.

beats.narration: The failures are visible: automation bias turns advice into command; compressed time removes deliberation; correlated sensors create false confidence; tactical optimization externalizes civilian harm, escalation, or long-run instability.
beats.visual_purpose: Join four failure mechanisms without collapsing their consequences.
beats.visual_action: Place four red failure nodes around the warning trace and connect each to its distinct authority, time, evidence, or consequence break.
beats.attention_target: The four different broken boundaries.
beats.object_before: Failures are distributed across earlier scenes.
beats.object_after: Four named failures remain distinct but joined to one command-and-interaction trace.
beats.composition: Warning trace center; four failure nodes at cardinal points; consequence residual below.
beats.motion_curve: Failures arrive in causal order and join only after their local breaks are visible.
beats.hold_purpose: Let distinct mechanisms remain diagnosable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Failure taxonomy does not estimate prevalence or risk.

beats.narration: Today this chapter provides a design rationale, a command-and-interaction taxonomy, and a public-safe governance architecture for synthetic scenarios.
beats.visual_purpose: Name the three exact supported artifacts at argument level.
beats.visual_action: Place rationale, role taxonomy, and safe architecture inside an amber support frame labeled ARGUMENT.
beats.attention_target: The three supported artifacts inside the frame.
beats.object_before: The joined failure map could be mistaken for an evaluated system.
beats.object_after: Three argument-level artifacts occupy a bounded support frame.
beats.composition: Supported artifact tiles left; support frame center; empty claim side right.
beats.motion_curve: Three tiles settle before the boundary appears.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the current support set register before non-claims arrive.
beats.evidence_boundary: Argument support only.

beats.narration: It does not test a deployed military system, authorize a weapon, establish lawful use, or measure strategic stability.
beats.sync_anchor: does not test a deployed military system
beats.visual_purpose: Block deployment, authority, lawfulness, and stability promotion.
beats.visual_action: Draw the magenta evidence boundary and stop four prohibited claim tiles as they approach from the right.
beats.attention_target: The four claim tiles stopped outside support.
beats.object_before: Three supported artifacts sit in an argument frame with unused space beside them.
beats.object_after: Four prohibited claims remain visibly outside the evidence boundary.
beats.composition: Supported frame left, vertical evidence boundary center, prohibited claims right.
beats.motion_curve: Claim tiles approach sequentially and stop at the same boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the derivative from promoting the chapter.
beats.evidence_boundary: Argument support only.

beats.narration: Its maximum inference is narrow. Mission, authority, provenance, judgment, safe-posture, interaction, off-ramp, secrecy, and decommission records make responsibility inspectable. Complete records do not prove truth or effectiveness.
beats.sync_anchor: Complete records do not prove truth
beats.visual_purpose: Separate inspectable completeness from truth and effectiveness.
beats.visual_action: Assemble nine record chips into a bounded packet, then stop TRUTH and EFFECTIVE badges outside its maximum-inference seal.
beats.attention_target: The maximum-inference seal around the packet.
beats.object_before: Supported architecture fields appear as separate artifacts.
beats.object_after: A bounded packet makes responsibility inspectable while truth and effectiveness remain outside.
beats.composition: Nine chips center, maximum-inference seal around them, prohibited badges right.
beats.motion_curve: Chips assemble in causal groups; seal closes; badges stop outside.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the exact inference boundary scan as one object.
beats.evidence_boundary: Record completeness only.

beats.narration: Military AI becomes governable when local model performance remains subordinate to accountable command, interaction-aware evaluation, preserved decision time, bounded effects, and reversible authority.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the chapter into a compact command-and-interaction invariant.
beats.visual_action: Place local model performance inside a smaller inner ring and surround it with five governing outer rings that remain visibly dominant.
beats.attention_target: The smaller model-performance ring inside the governance system.
beats.object_before: A bounded packet lists responsibilities and non-claims.
beats.object_after: Local performance sits subordinate to command, interaction, time, effect, and reversibility.
beats.composition: Model score center; five concentric governing rings; residual remains outside but owned.
beats.motion_curve: Small center settles; outer rings close in measured succession.
beats.camera_action: Pull back for the governing-system payoff.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the hierarchy memorable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design rationale, not demonstrated governance.

beats.narration: Next, Evidence States and Claim Discipline asks how every assertion, test, limitation, and revision remains tied to the support it actually earned.
beats.visual_purpose: Transfer the bounded military-AI packet into the book's evidence-state lifecycle.
beats.visual_action: Keep the no-authority seal on the packet, carry it across a vertical handoff axis, and open ASSERTION, TEST, LIMIT, and REVISION lanes in the next chapter.
beats.attention_target: The unchanged no-authority seal during handoff.
beats.object_before: A governed but argument-only command-and-interaction packet remains local.
beats.object_after: The same bounded packet enters an evidence-state ledger without promotion.
beats.composition: Bounded packet left, handoff axis center, evidence-state lanes right.
beats.motion_curve: Packet moves slowly; next-chapter lanes unfold after it stops.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve identity and evidence ceiling into the successor chapter.
beats.evidence_boundary: No support-state or publication effect.
